scripts.text:
[Cool Devi]
If you have something to say to him,
just talk to me.
You won't even understand what stupid pumkin headed Jack is saying.
scripts.translation:
[酷黛維]
你有什麼話想對他說，直接跟我說就好。
那個笨蛋南瓜頭傑克說的話，你根本聽不懂。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你攜帶的物品太多了，請先使用卡普拉服務存放部分物品，再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
Oh wait, is that a Pumpkin Mojo you are carrying?
 
[Cool Devi]
Says he.
scripts.translation:
[陰鬱的傑克]
哦等等，你身上帶的是南瓜的精髓嗎？

[酷黛維]
他是這麼說的。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
Give it to me. I'll pay you back.
 
[Cool Devi]
Says he...
I just can guess what he will say next. So what do you say?
scripts.translation:
[陰鬱的傑克]
把它給我，我會報答你的。

[酷黛維]
他是這麼說的...
我都猜得到他接下來要說什麼了，你呢？

scripts.text: What will he say?
scripts.translation: 他會說什麼？

scripts.text: I also know about it.
scripts.translation: 我也知道

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What will he say?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他會說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Cool Devi]
Jack is not like others. He is halloween Jack.
but one day, he lost his Pumpkin Mojo and turned into depressed Jack..
Pumpkin Mojo was his all.
scripts.translation:
[酷黛維]
傑克跟別人不一樣。他是萬聖節的傑克。
但有一天，他失去了南瓜的精髓，變成了陰鬱的傑克...
南瓜的精髓是他的一切。

scripts.text:
[Cool Devi]
Well, actually that's the main reason Jack came to town.
To find his Pumpkin Mojo. Most suspicious suspect is ^4d4dffDelightful Lude^000000, the one known as Halloween monster
scripts.translation:
[酷黛維]
其實，傑克來城裡就是為了找回南瓜的精髓。
最可疑的傢伙是^4d4dff南瓜魂^000000，也就是那個有名的萬聖節魔物。

scripts.text:
[Cool Devi]
Why don't you give him back the 'Pumpkin Mojo'.
Don't worry he will compensate you.
scripts.translation:
[酷黛維]
把“南瓜的精髓”還給他怎麼樣？
放心，他會報答你的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Compensate?With what?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
補償？用什麼補償？

scripts.text:
[Cool Devi]
If you bring ^4d4dff 1 Pumpkin Mojo^000000 and a pumpkin head that we gave out to you last year,
he will make it to ^00ff00the most fantastic pumpkin hat^000000.
Or if you don't have pumpkin head, you can just bring a ^3d3dff Pumpkin Mojo, a pumpkin, and a cap ^000000.
scripts.translation:
[酷黛維]
帶來^4d4dff1個南瓜的精髓^000000和去年我們送給你的南瓜頭，他就能將它做成^00ff00最華麗的南瓜帽^000000。
如果沒有南瓜頭，也可以帶^3d3dff1個南瓜的精髓、1個南瓜和1頂帽子^000000來。

scripts.text:
[Cool Devi]
Well, that Pumpkin Mojo is useless if you just carry it. 
Give it to Jack. Don't you feel pity for him?.
scripts.translation:
[酷黛維]
南瓜的精髓放在你身上也沒什麼用，給傑克吧。
你不覺得他很可憐嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cool Devi]
Oh~Great.
Then, let me see what you got.
scripts.translation:
[酷黛維]
哦~太好了。
那麼，讓我看看你帶了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
Oh, you brought the pumpkin head!
I'll make you to nicer one.
 
[Cool Devi]
says he.
scripts.translation:
[陰鬱的傑克]
哦，你帶了南瓜頭來！
我會給你做一個更漂亮的。

[酷黛維]
他是這麼說的。

scripts.text: No, I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 稍後再來

scripts.text: Oh, good. Make it now!
scripts.translation: 好，現在就做

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
Huh?
 
[Cool Devi]
What? Look at Jack. He has got so dissapointed.
Promise me to give the Pumpkin Mojo back to Jack later someday, will you?
scripts.translation:
[陰鬱的傑克]
嗯？

[酷黛維]
什麼？你看傑克，多失望啊。
答應我，以後一定把南瓜的精髓還給他，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
Thanks for giving my thing back, I'll make your hat prettier.
 
[Cool Devi]
says he.
scripts.translation:
[陰鬱的傑克]
謝謝你把東西還給我，我會把你的帽子做得更漂亮。

[酷黛維]
他是這麼說的。

scripts.text:
[Excited Jack]
Lalala~ lalala~
 
(He starts singing. On a sudden, Jack's aura appeared.)
scripts.translation:
[興奮的傑克]
Lalala~ lalala~
 
（他開始唱歌，傑克的靈氣突然顯現了。）

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
My aura is not like it used to be. Maybe I need more Pumpkin Mojo.
 
[Cool Devi]
says he...
scripts.translation:
[陰鬱的傑克]
我的靈氣不如從前了，也許還需要更多南瓜的精髓。

[酷黛維]
他是這麼說的...

scripts.text:
[Cool Devi]
Oh~poor Jack.
Well, someday he'll get back all his Pumpkin Mojo back.
scripts.translation:
[酷黛維]
哦~可憐的傑克。
不過，總有一天他會找回所有南瓜的精髓。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
Wow!
I'll turn your hat to very cool one.
 
[Cool Devi]
says he...
scripts.translation:
[陰鬱的傑克]
哇！
我會把你的帽子變得特別酷。

[酷黛維]
他是這麼說的...

[Cool Devi]
Hey,there. You don't seem to have all materials for the fantastic hat.
scripts.translation:
[酷黛維]
喂，看來你還沒帶齊製作那頂華麗帽子的材料。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
Hey,there. Why don't you come here and listen to my story.
 
[Cool Devi]
Says he.
scripts.translation:
[陰鬱的傑克]
喂，過來聽聽我的故事吧。

[酷黛維]
他是這麼說的。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Jack]
I used to be very famous. But now.....
 
[Cool Devi]
Says he...
Well, I'll just tell you without translating.
scripts.translation:
[陰鬱的傑克]
我以前可是很有名的，但現在...

[酷黛維]
他是這麼說的...
算了，我直接告訴你吧，不用翻譯了。

scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你攜帶的物品太多了，請先使用卡普拉服務存放部分物品，再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Pumpkin is the gift that God had sent us.
It provides good nutrition and helps you to stay healthy!
Bravo~bravo~!
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
南瓜是上帝賜予我們的禮物。
它營養豐富，有助於保持健康！
太棒了~太棒了~！

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
I, Hoirin have always thought about a 
way to eat pumpkin more deliciously.
But all of a sudden, I realized.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
我霍伊琳一直在琢磨，怎樣才能把南瓜做得更好吃。
突然，我想到了。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
If I have that! I can make best the Pumpkin pie!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
只要有那個，我就能做出最棒的南瓜派！！！！！

scripts.text: What's that?
scripts.translation: 那是什麼？

scripts.text: Ignore.
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
What's the first image you see when you think of pumpkin?
I see Jack! I think Jack is the most evolved form of pumpkin!
I wonder what does Jack have something special? Can you imagine?
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
一提到南瓜，你最先想到什麼？
我想到的就是傑克！我覺得傑克就是南瓜進化的終極形態！
傑克到底有什麼特別的呢？你猜得到嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
I always prefer unique pumpkin dish! Recently, I found out that there are many kinds of Jack in the world 
and the extreme class Jack has blue aura around his body!
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
我就喜歡獨特的南瓜料理！
最近我發現，世上有很多種傑克，而最厲害的傑克全身都環繞著藍色靈氣！

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Guess what?! it was Halloween Jack!
Halloween Jack has somthing that is concentrated with pumpkin.
It is called ^4d4dffPumpkin Mojo^000000. Only if i have it, i can finish making my special pie.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
你猜那是什麼？！就是萬聖節傑克！
他身上有一種濃縮了南瓜精華的東西，叫作^4d4dff南瓜的精髓^000000。
有了它，我的特製南瓜派就能完成了。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Bring me the ingredients!
I'll make you a very special pie right away!
You'll get addicted to it.
Don't be surprised after trying it.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
把材料帶給我！
我會立刻為你做一個非常特別的派！
你會對它上癮的。
嘗過之後別驚訝。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
......................
You seem to be such a passionate person.
So, what's the ingredient anyway.?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...
你還真是熱情啊。
所以，到底需要什麼材料？

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Good question!
To make my special Pumpkin pie, I need
^4d4dff 1 Pumpkin Mojo
2 Pumpkin
2 Egg^000000
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
問得好！
做我的特製南瓜派需要：
^4d4dff1個南瓜的精髓
2個南瓜
2個雞蛋^000000

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Just Bring Pumpkin Mojo, Pumpkin, and a Egg.
Leave the rest for me..You'll get to try the best pumkin pie!
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
只要帶南瓜的精髓、南瓜和雞蛋來就好。
剩下的交給我...你會嚐到最棒的南瓜派！

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Hm..You'll regret it!
Hoirin's pumpkin pie is just so delicious.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
哼...你會後悔的！
霍伊琳的南瓜派可是非常美味的。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
So, did you bring all materials?
Were there anything hard to find?
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
那麼，你把材料都帶齊了嗎？
有沒有什麼很難找的東西？

scripts.text: I brought all ingredients.
scripts.translation: 帶齊材料了

scripts.text: How can I get eggs?
scripts.translation: 我該怎麼弄到雞蛋？

scripts.text: No,I'm just passing by.
scripts.translation: 只是路過

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
You are right!
You brought all things right. Give it to me!!
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
沒錯！
你把東西都帶對了。快給我！！

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Abracadabra~~
Abracadabra~~!
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
Abracadabra~~
Abracadabra~~!

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Ta-da(h)!
Here it is~ help yourself.
It'll be good for your health. I added extra nutrient in it.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
Ta-da(h)!
做好啦~請享用。
我還額外加了營養，對身體很有好處哦。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
No!! This is not enough. I need
^4d4dff 1 Pumpkin Mojo
2 Pumpkin
2 Egg^000000
 at least.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
不！！這些還不夠，至少需要：
^4d4dff1個南瓜的精髓
2個南瓜
2個雞蛋^000000

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Egg?
Well, actually I know someone who can help you.
There's a man who raise many chickens.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
雞蛋？
嗯，其實我認識一個能幫你的傢伙。
有個男子養了很多小雞。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
I can send you to where he is if you want.
^4d4dffBut only for once^000000.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
如果你願意，我可以把你送到他那裡。
^4d4dff但只有一次機會^000000。

scripts.text: Send me.
scripts.translation: 送我過去

scripts.text: It's ok.
scripts.translation: 不用了

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Ok, go get the eggs.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
好，去拿雞蛋吧。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Do you think you can go without my help?!
Ok! go ahead.
Do you know where it is?
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
你覺得沒有我的幫忙也能去嗎？！
好吧！去吧。
你知道在哪裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
if you go to ^4d4dfffarm of Skelington Town at Neiflheim^000000, you'll meet Chicken Masta. He raises chickens.
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
去^4d4dff尼芙菲姆骷髏鎮的農場^000000，就能找到炸雞大師，他養了很多雞。

scripts.text:
[Hoirin]
Next time, don't forget to bring 
all the ingredients for pumpkin pie!
scripts.translation:
[霍伊琳]
下次，別忘了帶齊做南瓜派的所有材料！

[Deviruchi]
Hey there, if you have something to say to Loli Ruri, talk to me.
She's not used to human language.
scripts.translation:
[小惡魔]
嘿，如果你想對蘿莉·露莉說什麼，就跟我說話吧。
她不習慣人類的語言。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!

too many things with you.

using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你攜帶的物品太多了，請先使用卡普拉服務存放部分物品，再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Loli Ruri]
Devi~Where's the pumpkin pie?
Humans make them, don't they?
Do you have it then?
 
[Deviruchi]
Says she.
scripts.translation:
[蘿莉·露莉]
黛維~南瓜派在哪裡？
是人類做的，對吧？
你有嗎？
 
[小惡魔]
她是這麼說的。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
If you have a pumpinkin pie, can I have one?
Cause we are the victim if Loli Ruri gets mad.
scripts.translation:
[小惡魔]
你有南瓜派的話，能給我一個嗎？
蘿莉·露莉一生氣，遭殃的可是我們啊。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Well I'm not saying that I want it for free.
Don't worry, I won't let you down.
scripts.translation:
[小惡魔]
我可不是說想要白拿。
別擔心，我不會讓你失望的。

scripts.text: Give him the pumpkin pie.
scripts.translation: 把南瓜派給他

scripts.text: Do not give him the pumpkin pie.
scripts.translation: 不把南瓜派給他

scripts.text: Huh? What pumkin pie?
scripts.translation: 什麼南瓜派？

scripts.text:
[Loli Ruri]
Thanks for the pumkin pie!
Here, take this.
 
[Deviruchi]
Says she.
scripts.translation:
[蘿莉·露莉]
謝謝你的南瓜派！
拿著這個。
 
[小惡魔]
她是這麼說的。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
As I promised, I'll give you something worth the pie.
Hang on....
scripts.translation:
[小惡魔]
說到做到，我會拿價值相當的東西來換你的南瓜派。
稍等...

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Hmm...This would be good.
Here take this, and thanks again~
scripts.translation:
[小惡魔]
嗯...這個不錯。
拿著吧，再次感謝~

scripts.text:
[Loli Ruri]
Are you kidding me?
Where's the pumpkin pie! Don't try to lie to me!
 
[Deviruchi]
Say she..Seems like she's very angry...You are in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[蘿莉·露莉]
你在開玩笑嗎？
南瓜派在哪裡！別想騙我！
 
[小惡魔]
她是這麼說的...看起來她很生氣...你麻煩大了。

scripts.text:
[Loli Ruri]
Devi!!!!!You are the one who told me that I can get the pumpkin pie if I stand here and wait.
Watch your back!
 
[Deviruchi]
Says she..Huh?!!Me?!!
scripts.translation:
[蘿莉·露莉]
黛維！！！！！是你說我只要站在這裡等，就能拿到南瓜派的！
你給我小心點！
 
[小惡魔]
她是這麼說的...啊？！！我？！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Poor Devi~
You shouldn't have lied~
Wish you a luck.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
可憐的黛維~
你不該撒謊~
祝你好運。

[Deviruchi]

scripts.translation:

我想吃南瓜派，給我一個好不好？拜託~~~~
 
[小惡魔]
她是這麼說的...有的話就給我吧。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
There's a man who makes a very special pumpkin pie.
No one can forget what it taste like.
scripts.translation:
[小惡魔]
有個男人做的南瓜派非常特別。
沒人能忘記那個味道。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Lori Ruri is waiting here for someone who will get the pie for him.
Can you get her one?
I'll treat you back.
scripts.translation:

蘿莉·露莉在這裡等著有人給她帶派。
你能給她帶一個嗎？
我會回報你的。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Where did the chicken have gone?!
Oh, hey stranger. How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[炸雞大師]
小雞都跑到哪裡去了？！
哦，嘿，陌生人。有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
This town is too dangerous for you to hang around.
You'd better go back to where you came from....
scripts.translation:
[炸雞大師]
這鎮子太危險了，你可別在這裡亂逛。
還是從哪兒來就回哪兒去吧...

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
...Are you looking for eggs?
Recently, people are asking me for eggs to make some kind of pie....are you one of them?
scripts.translation:
[炸雞大師]
...你在找雞蛋嗎？
最近總有人來找我要雞蛋，說要做什麼派...你也是嗎？

scripts.text: Actually, yes. I came here to get some eggs.
scripts.translation: 是的，我來買雞蛋

scripts.text: Nope.
scripts.translation: 不是

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Ok. But some of my chickens ran away,
so I have no eggs much left.
1000 zeny for 2 eggs! how's that?
scripts.translation:
[炸雞大師]
好，不過我的雞跑掉了幾隻，剩下的雞蛋不多。
1000 Zeny買2個雞蛋！怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Ok,I'll take it.
scripts.translation: 好，我買了

scripts.text: I'll just buy one.
scripts.translation: 我只買一個

scripts.text: Whew~it's too expensive.
scripts.translation: 呼~太貴了

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Thanks.
Here are the eggs.
scripts.translation:
[炸雞大師]
謝謝。
這是你的雞蛋。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Hey this is not enough~
1000zeny per each, so if you buy two,that means 2000zeny.
scripts.translation:
[炸雞大師]
嘿，這不夠啊~
每個1000 Zeny，買兩個的話就是2000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Thanks.
Here are the eggs.
scripts.translation:
[炸雞大師]
謝謝。
這是你的雞蛋。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
You don't seem to have enough money...
It's 1000 zeny per each.
scripts.translation:
[炸雞大師]
你似乎錢不夠...
每個1000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Well...I know it's liitle bit expensive but as I told you, my chickens ran away.
You have to understand.
scripts.translation:
[炸雞大師]
嗯...我知道有點貴，但正如我告訴你的，我的小雞跑掉了。
你要體諒一下。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Let me tell you just one thing!
If you don't want to die,
you'd better run away. It's too dangerous in here.
scripts.translation:
[炸雞大師]
我就告訴你一句話！
不想死就趕緊跑，這裡太危險了。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Do you need eggs?...
Then, help me first.
8 of my chickens ran away.
I just don't know where they are.
scripts.translation:
[炸雞大師]
你需要雞蛋嗎？...
那麼，先幫個忙。
我的8只小雞跑掉了。
我完全不知道它們在哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
I don't expect all chickens to come back home.
Only if you find me one of them, I'll sell three eggs for you.
scripts.translation:
[炸雞大師]
我不指望所有小雞都能回家。
只要你幫我找回一隻，我就賣三個雞蛋給你。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Isn't it a great deal?
Chickens must be around here somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[炸雞大師]
這不是很划算嗎？
小雞應該就在附近某處。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
You don't have to bring back chickens to me if you find one,
Just insert the word ^4d4dff'Return'^000000.
.........
scripts.translation:
[炸雞大師]
找到雞以後，不用把它帶回來，只要輸入^4d4dff'Return'^000000就行。
...

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
It's a spell to make chickens to go back home.
.........
Don't forget the word 'Return'!
scripts.translation:
[炸雞大師]
這是讓雞回家的咒語。
...
記住，是'Return'！

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
I hope you can find my chickens.
scripts.translation:
[炸雞大師]
希望你能找到我的小雞。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Oh, you came back. I've been waiting for you.
And thanks for the chickens you sent me.
They are saftly kept in the henhouse, in case of running away again.
scripts.translation:
[炸雞大師]
哦，你回來了。我一直在等你。
還有，謝謝你送回來的小雞。
它們被安全地關在雞舍裡，以防再次跑掉。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
I didn't forget what we have promised.
Tell me how many eggs you want.
It's 1000zeny per each.
And maximum 3 is all you can get.
scripts.translation:
[炸雞大師]
我沒忘記我們的約定。
告訴我你想要多少個雞蛋。
每個1000 Zeny。
最多隻能買3個。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
You don't have to buy it, if you don't need it.
scripts.translation:
[炸雞大師]
如果你不需要，就不必買了。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
What did I tell you.
I'm going to sell only three eggs.
scripts.translation:
[炸雞大師]
我怎麼跟你說的？
最多隻賣3個雞蛋。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
You don't seem to have enough zeny.
scripts.translation:
[炸雞大師]
你的Zeny好像不夠。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Here you are.
But no more.
If you want more eggs, find me more chickens.
scripts.translation:
[炸雞大師]
給你。
但不能再多了。
如果你想要更多雞蛋，就幫我找回更多小雞。

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
Where did the chicken have gone?!
Oh, hey stranger. How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[炸雞大師]
小雞都跑到哪裡去了？！
哦，嘿，陌生人。有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chicken Masta]
This town is too dangerous for you to hang around.
You'd better go back to where you came from....
scripts.translation:
[炸雞大師]
這鎮子太危險了，你可別在這裡亂逛。
還是從哪兒來就回哪兒去吧...

scripts.text: Drowsing chicken.
scripts.translation: 正在打盹的小雞。

scripts.text:
Oh, this must be Chicken Masta's chicken.
I should insert the magic word.
scripts.translation:
哦，這一定是炸雞大師的小雞。
我應該輸入那個魔法單詞。

scripts.text: The magic spell has been casted.
scripts.translation: 魔法咒語已經施放了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hm...I must have misspelled.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...我一定是拼錯了。

scripts.translation: 正在打盹的小雞。

scripts.text:
As soon as you got close to the chicken and touched it, it disappeared completely.
You got an 'egg' in the place where the chicken disappeared.
scripts.translation:
當你靠近小雞並觸碰它時，它完全消失了。
在小雞消失的地方，你獲得了一枚“蛋”。

scripts.text:
[Familiar]
Hello.
I'm Loli Ruri's faithful and cute Familiar.
Do you have an invitation from Loli Ruri?
That's a kind of^4d4dffa special ticket to Niflheim^000000..
scripts.translation:
[使魔]
你好。
我是蘿莉·露莉忠誠又可愛的使魔。
你有她的邀請函嗎？
那可是^4d4dff前往尼芙菲姆的特製門票^000000...

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 有

scripts.text: No, I don't.
scripts.translation: 沒有

scripts.text:
[Familiar]
Do you want to go to Niflheim?
It's available during Halloween.
scripts.translation:
[使魔]
你想去尼芙菲姆嗎？
萬聖節期間可以前往。

scripts.text: Yes, I do
scripts.translation: 想去

scripts.text: No, I don't.
scripts.translation: 不去

scripts.text:
[Familiar]
I checked your ticket.
You can go there now
scripts.translation:
[使魔]
我檢查了你的門票。
你現在可以過去了。

scripts.text:
[Familiar]
You're a liar.
You don't have the ticket!
I'll suck up all your blood, you liar!
scripts.translation:
[使魔]
你是個騙子。
你沒有門票！
我要吸乾你的血，你這個騙子！

scripts.text:
[Familiar]
Ok.
Actually, it's useless to have a special ticket to Niflheim.
scripts.translation:
[使魔]
好吧。
其實，拿著前往尼芙菲姆的特製門票也沒什麼用。

scripts.text:
[Familiar]
Ok.
If you want to ask something, give a piece of pumpkin pie to Loli Ruri.
He likes it.
scripts.translation:
[使魔]
好吧。
想問點什麼，就給蘿莉·露莉一塊南瓜派，她很喜歡吃。
